sentences.en: It's been four years since the 2016 election demonstrated the powerful role that social media companies have come to play in shaping political discourse and beliefs in America.
sentences.zh: 距离2016年大选展示社交媒体公司在塑造美国政治话语和信念方面发挥的强大作用，已经过去四年了。

sentences.en: Since then, there have been growing calls to address the spread of polarization and misinformation promoted on these platforMs. While Facebook has been slower to
sentences.zh: 从那时起，呼吁解决这些平台上助长的极端化和虚假信息传播的声音日益高涨。虽然Facebook在

sentences.en: acknowledge a need for change, Twitter has embraced it and said that they made mistakes.
sentences.zh: 承认需要改变方面比较慢，但Twitter已经接受了这一点，并表示他们犯过错误。

sentences.en: But with three months to go until the 2020 election, these changes have been incremental, while Twitter itself is more popular than ever.
sentences.zh: 但距离2020年大选还有三个月之际，这些改变都是渐进的，而Twitter本身比以往任何时候都更受欢迎。

sentences.en: Today, a conversation with Twitter's CEO, Jack Dorsey, about whether those changes will be enough.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将与Twitter首席执行官杰克·多西进行对话，讨论这些改变是否足够。

sentences.en: It's Friday, August 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月7日，星期五。

sentences.en: Hey there.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 听得到我吗？

sentences.en: Hey, Jack.
sentences.zh: 嘿，杰克。

sentences.en: It's Michael.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: Was that a, your icon, was that you as a child or that was a child?
sentences.zh: 刚才那个，你的头像，那是你小时候还是只是个小孩？

sentences.en: That was me as a child.
sentences.zh: 那是我小时候。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: How old?
sentences.zh: 多大？

sentences.en: Um, maybe three or four.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大概三四岁吧。

sentences.en: And what should we deduce from the fact that your icon is a child?
sentences.zh: 那根据你的头像是小孩子这件事，我们应该推断出什么呢？

sentences.en: Uh, well, it's, it's me.
sentences.zh: 呃，好吧，这，这就是我。

sentences.en: It's, it's not just a child.
sentences.zh: 这，这不仅仅是个小孩。

sentences.en: Um, so, I don't know, the reminder.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，我不知道，算是一个提醒吧。

sentences.en: The inner child?
sentences.zh: 内心的孩童？

sentences.en: The innocent child?
sentences.zh: 天真无邪的孩子？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, if you're ready, I think we are ready.
sentences.zh: 那么，如果你准备好了，我想我们也准备好了。

sentences.en: Ready.
sentences.zh: 准备好了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Um, Jack, I'm just going to start with an intentionally provocative question, which is, do you believe that you are one of the most powerful people on earth right now?
sentences.zh: 嗯，杰克，我打算从一个故意具有挑衅性的问题开始，那就是，你认为自己现在是地球上最有权势的人之一吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Not, not at all.
sentences.zh: 完全，完全不是。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: And, and why not?
sentences.zh: 那，为什么不是呢？

sentences.en: Um, well, because if it's a reference to the, the power Twitter has, I think that power is ultimately in the hands of the people that use it every single day.
sentences.zh: 嗯，好吧，因为如果这是指Twitter拥有的权力，我认为这种权力最终掌握在每天使用它的普通人手中。

sentences.en: And, and that's, that's been the thing that is most special about the service is that everything that has made
sentences.zh: 而这，正是这项服务最特别的地方，那就是所有让

sentences.en: Twitter powerful has come from the people using it.
sentences.zh: Twitter变得强大的因素都来自于使用它的人民。

sentences.en: The people really push the direction of where the service goes and what it is and what it wants to be.
sentences.zh: 人们真正推动了服务的发展方向、它的本质以及它想要成为什么。

sentences.en: And our job as a company, my job as an individual at the company is to, is to be a checkpoint on that.
sentences.zh: 而我们作为一家公司的职责，我作为公司个人的职责，就是对这一点进行监督。

sentences.en: Um.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But isn't that in many ways what you're, you're grappling with?
sentences.zh: 但从很多方面来看，这难道不是你正在努力应对的问题吗？

sentences.en: The way in which the people and in a way the unchecked power of the people has transformed Twitter.
sentences.zh: 人们以及某种程度上人民不受制衡的权力改变Twitter的方式。

sentences.en: And isn't that a lot of what we're seeing from you now, an effort to kind of moderate that, to rein it in, to, to intervene in some way, to control that power?
sentences.zh: 我们现在从你身上看到的很多现象，难道不正是为了缓和这种权力、加以抑制、以某种方式进行干预、控制这种权力的努力吗？

sentences.en: I, I don't think it's unchecked power.
sentences.zh: 我，我不认为这是不受制衡的权力。

sentences.en: Um, first, I think that the people are constantly checking themselves and that's what you see in public conversation in the first place.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，我认为人们一直在自我约束，这正是你在公共对话中首先看到的。

sentences.en: What, what we're dealing with though is people gaming systems, people taking unfair advantage of systems, people setting up accounts in order to manipulate conversation.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们正在处理的是人们钻系统的空子、人们不公平地利用系统、人们建立账号来操纵对话。

sentences.en: And that's where, um, you know, we really need to focus our energy is, is that audience unfairly earned?
sentences.zh: 这就是，嗯，你知道，我们需要真正集中精力的，是那种受众是不劳而获的吗？

sentences.en: Is it captured in some way that isn't consistent with reality, which would be a flaw in our system?
sentences.zh: 它是否以某种不符合现实的方式被捕获了，这会是我们系统的一个漏洞吗？

sentences.en: But are we also dealing with people checking, not just themselves, but each other?
sentences.zh: 但我们是否也在应对人们不仅在约束自己，还在约束彼此的情况？

sentences.en: And I didn't intend to go here so quickly, but, but this idea of cancel culture that is so present in our society
sentences.zh: 我本没打算这么快切入这个话题，但是，但是当今我们社会中如此普遍的这种取消文化理念，

sentences.en: right now, doesn't that have to do with something that doesn't have to do with gaming systems or
sentences.zh: 这难道不与那些无关系统漏洞或

sentences.en: taking unfair advantage of them, but rather with the incentive structure of Twitter itself?
sentences.zh: 不公平利用系统的事物有关，而是与Twitter本身的激励机制有关吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think you're spot on with incentives.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得你一针见血地指出了激励机制的问题。

sentences.en: You know, I think if, if we're to do all this over again and rewind the disciplines that we were lacking in the company in the early days that I wish
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想如果我们要重来一次，回顾我们在公司早期缺乏的规训，我希望

sentences.en: we would have understood and hired for are like a game theorist to just really understand the
sentences.zh: 我们当时能理解并聘用的人才，比如游戏理论家，以便真正理解

sentences.en: ramifications of tiny decisions that we make, such as what happens with retweet versus retweet with comment.
sentences.zh: 我们所做的小决定的后果，例如转发与带评论转发会发生什么。

sentences.en: And, uh, what happens when you put a count next to a like button?
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，当你把一个计数器放在点赞按钮旁边时会发生什么？

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 这意味着什么？

sentences.en: So a game theorist, a behavioral economist to help us understand incentives and then social scientists.
sentences.zh: 所以需要游戏理论家、行为经济学家来帮助我们理解激励机制，然后是社会学家。

sentences.en: Those are disciplines that we lacked that I think ultimately would have been important
sentences.zh: 这些是我们当时缺乏的学科，我认为它们最终对于

sentences.en: helping us think about not just building a product, but building something that people use socially and the ramifications of that.
sentences.zh: 帮助我们不仅思考如何构建产品，而且思考如何构建人们在社交中使用的东西及其后果，会非常重要。

sentences.en: Meaning if that people were using this for more and more conversation, for more and more speech, this is less about building a product and more about how people
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果人们将其用于越来越多的对话，用于越来越多的言论，这就不再是关于构建产品，而是关于人与人之间如何

sentences.en: interrelate with one another, how people converse with one another.
sentences.zh: 相互交往，人与人之间如何对话。

sentences.en: But I think, you know, to me, these things tend to be pendulum swings.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，你知道，对我来说，这些事情往往是钟摆式的摆动。

sentences.en: And while we do see a lot of what you're labeling as cancel culture today, I do think it's important that we continue to allow the space for people to
sentences.zh: 虽然我们今天确实看到了很多你所贴上“取消文化”标签的现象，但我确实认为，我们继续为人们提供空间来

sentences.en: express their past and their history and context.
sentences.zh: 表达他们的过去、历史和背景，这一点很重要。

sentences.en: Um, because I think context matters so much because if we can't express that, we can't learn from it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为我认为背景非常重要，如果我们无法表达这些，我们就无法从中吸取教训。

sentences.en: And then we can't really progress and, or improve as a culture or as individuals either.
sentences.zh: 然后作为一种文化或作为个人，我们也无法真正取得进展或改进。

sentences.en: You're, you're acknowledging that Twitter has become a difficult place for context.
sentences.zh: 你，你承认Twitter已经变成了一个难以容纳背景的地方。

sentences.en: I, it really depends on what part of Twitter you look at.
sentences.zh: 这，这真的取决于你看的是Twitter的哪一部分。

sentences.en: 80% of Twitter is outside the United
sentences.zh: Twitter上80%的用户都在美国

sentences.en: States.
sentences.zh: 之外。

sentences.en: 80% of Twitter doesn't really concern itself with what you're bringing up right now.
sentences.zh: Twitter上80%的用户并不真的关心你现在提出的问题。

sentences.en: In politics and news Twitter, certainly there's different ways of using it that, you know, some of which are great because they hold power to account.
sentences.zh: 在政治和新闻类Twitter上，当然有不同的使用方式，你知道，其中一些很好，因为它们让当权者承担责任。

sentences.en: Some are not because it doesn't allow for an evolution of an individual or an institution or, or learning, but there are multiple Twitters happening in parallel all the time.
sentences.zh: 有些则不然，因为它不允许个人或机构的发展、学习，但是有多个Twitter一直在并行发生。

sentences.en: And we in the U S and especially in the media tend to focus on one small like sliver of it that does have real impact in the world.
sentences.zh: 而我们在美国，尤其是在媒体领域，往往专注于其中对世界产生真实影响的一小部分切片。

sentences.en: But, you know, from a company and service perspective, we have to pay attention to something so much larger.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，从公司和服务的角度来看，我们必须关注更大得多的东西。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, we also have a leader in the United States who engages in that small sliver in a very big way.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们在美国也有一位以非常大的力度参与这一小部分切片的领导人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I want to talk about all of this that we're starting to dabble in, in much greater depth,
sentences.zh: 我想更深入地探讨我们刚刚开始涉足的这一切，

sentences.en: but you seem to be saying that some very essential elements of Twitter from, from the start may contain flaws, have contained flaws or turned out to be flaws.
sentences.zh: 但你似乎在说，Twitter从一开始的一些非常核心的要素可能包含漏洞，曾经包含漏洞，或者后来证明是漏洞。

sentences.en: But I'd like to go back with you to the very beginning to understand how it is that we got here.
sentences.zh: 但我还是想和你一起回到最初，去理解我们是如何走到这一步的。

sentences.en: And I want to understand what you thought you were making and what you actually have created.
sentences.zh: 我想了解你当时以为自己在制造什么，以及你实际创造了什么。

sentences.en: So what did you imagine Twitter was going to be when you created it?
sentences.zh: 所以，当你创造Twitter时，你想象它会是什么样子？

sentences.en: And for that matter, why did you create it?
sentences.zh: 话说回来，你为什么要创造它？

sentences.en: What was it supposed to do?
sentences.zh: 它本来应该用来做什么？

sentences.en: Well, I think Twitter is unique.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为Twitter是独一无二的。

sentences.en: Um, and certainly to us in that it wasn't something we really invented.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对我们来说当然也是如此，因为它并不是我们真正发明的东西。

sentences.en: It was something we discovered and we kept pulling the thread on it.
sentences.zh: 它是我们发现的，并且我们一直在顺藤摸瓜。

sentences.en: And in saying that we didn't really have any specific intent around what it should be or what it shouldn't be.
sentences.zh: 而且话说回来，对于它应该成为什么或不应该成为什么，我们并没有任何具体的意图。

sentences.en: We saw some opportunity and technology based on all of our backgrounds and experience.
sentences.zh: 根据我们的所有背景和经验，我们在技术中看到了一些机会。

sentences.en: Um, and we were also kind of thrust into a world that had, you know, a country that there was just getting access to SMS and we built it to use it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们也被推入这样一个世界，一个刚刚开始接触短信的国家，我们为了使用它而构建了它。

sentences.en: And, uh, immediately we felt it was incredible.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，我们立刻觉得这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: And the, the, the moment that we felt there was something there, at least for us was that, you know, we all went to our various homes or
sentences.zh: 而我们觉得事情有所成的时刻，至少对我们来说是这样的：你知道，当两周后系统终于开始运行后，我们各自回到了不同的家、

sentences.en: dinners or yoga sessions or whatever it was, uh, away from the office when it finally started working after two weeks.
sentences.zh: 晚餐地点、瑜伽课或是办公室以外的什么地方。

sentences.en: And, uh, we all were updating each other about what we were doing.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，我们都在互相更新我们在做什么。

sentences.en: And even though we weren't physically present with each other anymore, we felt together and it was, it was such an amazing
sentences.zh: 尽管我们不再彼此实体陪伴，但我们感觉在一起，那种感觉

sentences.en: feeling knowing that I would be sending an update and potentially it would buzz, you know, some of my
sentences.zh: 太棒了，知道我会发送一条更新，它可能会在，你知道的，我的一些

sentences.en: friends' pockets and they would take it out and they would understand in that moment immediately what I was going through, what I was thinking was very cool.
sentences.zh: 朋友的口袋里震动，他们会拿出来，立刻明白我当时正在经历什么、正在想什么，这非常酷。

sentences.en: It was instantaneous.
sentences.zh: 它是即时的。

sentences.en: And I was brought into that moment, the moment it was happening.
sentences.zh: 我被带入了那个时刻，就在它发生的那一刻。

sentences.en: Doesn't a text do that same thing?
sentences.zh: 短信不也能做到同样的事情吗？

sentences.en: So what felt so exciting about the fact that the reach of this would be unconstrained?
sentences.zh: 那么，这项技术的传播范围将是不受限制的，这一事实有什么让人兴奋的呢？

sentences.en: Exactly that.
sentences.zh: 正是这一点。

sentences.en: The reach was unconstrained.
sentences.zh: 传播范围是不受限制的。

sentences.en: It wasn't me choosing to send an update to these seven people.
sentences.zh: 不是我选择向这七个人发送更新。

sentences.en: It was me writing on the wall and people following updates from that wall.
sentences.zh: 是我在墙上写字，人们关注那面墙上的更新。

sentences.en: And the number of people following those updates could be infinite.
sentences.zh: 关注这些更新的人数可以是无限的。

sentences.en: It was a change in the model so that it was a broadcast and anyone could, could tune in effectively versus me selecting folks to receive a message.
sentences.zh: 这是模式上的改变，使其成为一种广播，任何人都可以有效地收听，而不是由我来选择接收消息的人。

sentences.en: So, so you understood early on that the potential was kind of huge.
sentences.zh: 所以，所以你很早就明白这种潜力是巨大的。

sentences.en: Well, no, I wouldn't necessarily say that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不，我不会一定这么说。

sentences.en: I would say that it felt amazing and it felt electric and it felt, um, you know, very powerful to us.
sentences.zh: 我会说这感觉太棒了，感觉很震撼，而且，嗯，对我们来说感觉非常强大。

sentences.en: But what really showed us Twitter were the people and how they used it and how they used it completely differently than how we used it.
sentences.zh: 但真正向我们展示Twitter的是人们，以及他们是如何使用它的，以及他们使用它的方式与我们完全不同。

sentences.en: So I want to talk about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我想谈谈这个。

sentences.en: I want to talk about what I see as the beginning of the transformation of Twitter and the act of tweeting.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈我所看到的Twitter转型和发推行为的开始。

sentences.en: And, and I see the start of that really as being the Arab spring, you know, young people in the Middle East using this new platform to call for change,
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这一切的开端实际上是阿拉伯之春，你知道，中东的年轻人利用这个新平台呼吁变革，

sentences.en: to document the calls for change, to document government's response to those calls, and ultimately to bring the change, right?
sentences.zh: 记录呼吁变革的声音，记录政府对这些呼吁的回应，并最终带来变革，对吧？

sentences.en: And really alter the course of history because governments during this period literally fell and rose.
sentences.zh: 并且真正改变了历史的进程，因为在此期间政府确实在兴衰交替。

sentences.en: And we see similar usage in the United States with Black Lives Matter.
sentences.zh: 我们在美国也看到了类似的用法，比如“黑人的命也是命”。

sentences.en: And it felt like that development in the usage of Twitter was, was very much celebrated, right?
sentences.zh: 感觉Twitter用法的这种发展受到了极大的赞誉，对吧？

sentences.en: Especially by progressives.
sentences.zh: 特别是受到进步人士的赞誉。

sentences.en: And it felt kind of noble.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉挺崇高的。

sentences.en: But this also represents, in my recollection, the beginning of Twitter as a pretty active agent in politics.
sentences.zh: 但据我回忆，这也代表了Twitter成为政治中一个相当活跃的代理人的开始。

sentences.en: And that brought a lot of changes to the platform, including hyperpolarization.
sentences.zh: 这给平台带来了很多变化，包括极端极化。

sentences.en: America's political discourse starts to play out on Twitter and it gets pretty nasty pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 美国的政治话语开始在Twitter上展开，而且很快就变得相当恶劣。

sentences.en: There's harassment, there's name calling, there's threats, there's anti-Semitism, there's racism.
sentences.zh: 这里有骚扰、有人身攻击、有威胁、有反犹太主义、有种族主义。

sentences.en: And the idea that everybody who disagrees with me or disagrees with you, you know, that they're just an evil idiot, that becomes a pretty powerful sentiment on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 而且那种认为所有不同意我或不同意你的人，你知道，他们只是个邪恶的白痴的观点，在Twitter上变成了一种相当强大的情绪。

sentences.en: And it becomes a powerful sentiment kind of quickly.
sentences.zh: 并且它以相当快的方式变成了一种强大的情绪。

sentences.en: And I know that I just ticked through a lot there.
sentences.zh: 我知道我刚才讲了很多。

sentences.en: So would you, would you agree with that basic depiction of the transformation?
sentences.zh: 那么你，你会同意这种对转型的基本描述吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's ignoring everything that happens on the internet in parallel as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得这忽视了互联网上同时发生的一切其他事情。

sentences.en: Abuse and harassment did not start after this polarization or the political dialogue coming on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 虐待和骚扰并不是在这种极化或政治对话进入Twitter之后才开始的。

sentences.en: It's been on the internet forever.
sentences.zh: 它在互联网上一直存在。

sentences.en: And certainly folks in the early days of Twitter experiencing abuse, hate, harassment, it just wasn't acknowledged, unfortunately, by us in the
sentences.zh: 当然，在Twitter早期经历滥用、仇恨、骚扰的人们，不幸的是，当时并没有得到我们

sentences.en: early days enough or by, you know, the general population and general media.
sentences.zh: 足够的认可，也没有得到广大公众和主流媒体的认可。

sentences.en: So the fact that there wasn't acknowledgement or even observation or stories about it doesn't mean that it wasn't happening.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使当时没有得到承认、甚至没有被观察到或报道，并不代表它没有发生过。

sentences.en: It was.
sentences.zh: 它确实发生了。

sentences.en: And it just wasn't being made visible enough and acknowledged enough.
sentences.zh: 只是它当时没有被足够清晰地展现出来，也没有得到足够的重视。

sentences.en: Are you saying that was a fundamental reality of human interaction, or at least of human interaction online, as opposed to a result of the incentives and the structures of Twitter?
sentences.zh: 你是说，这是人类互动的一种根本现实，或者至少是网络人类互动的一种现实，而不是推特的激励机制和结构所导致的结果？

sentences.en: It certainly has always been part of the structure of the internet and some of what it incentivizes as well versus not.
sentences.zh: 它当然一直是互联网结构的一部分，也与互联网所刺激的某些东西有关，而与其他东西无关。

sentences.en: And it's not to say that we didn't incentivize different ways or amplifying the behaviors that already existed, but digital communication has, has always seen the sort of
sentences.zh: 这并不是说我们没有通过不同的方式去激励或放大那些原本就存在的行为，但数字通信一直以来都有这种

sentences.en: attack and these sort of trends.
sentences.zh: 攻击以及诸如此类的趋势。

sentences.en: So I want to actually dig into what we mean when we talk about incentives and structures.
sentences.zh: 所以我其实想深入探讨一下，当我们谈论激励机制和结构时，到底指的是什么。

sentences.en: When it comes to incentives, what were they, as far as you could tell, on Twitter?
sentences.zh: 就激励机制而言，在你看来，推特上的激励机制到底是什么？

sentences.en: And how did they play a role in both the popularity and eventually the trouble that we're talking about here on the platform?
sentences.zh: 它们在我们在平台上谈论的流行度以及随之而来的麻烦中扮演了什么角色？

sentences.en: Well, I think choices around showing how many people follow you and that that number was bolded
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为围绕展示有多少人关注你的选择，以及这个数字在你的个人资料中被加粗

sentences.en: and big in your profile certainly incentivized me to make that number go up, right?
sentences.zh: 而且在你的个人资料中很醒目，这无疑激励着我去让这个数字不断上升，对吧？

sentences.en: Or anyone.
sentences.zh: 或者任何人都是如此。

sentences.en: Like, that's a number that, for whatever reason, this product thinks is important that inherently incentivizes people to grow that number as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 比如，不管出于什么原因，这个产品认为这是一个重要的数字，这本身就会激励人们尽最大努力让这个数字增长得越快越好。

sentences.en: The decisions we made around having a favorite button on a tweet and then shifting that to a like button and that button having a number associated with it.
sentences.zh: 我们所做出的决策包括：在推文上设置一个收藏按钮，然后将其转变为点赞按钮，并且让这个按钮带有一个数字计数。

sentences.en: So people wanting or constructing tweets that went viral and spread as quickly as possible through retweet numbers.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们希望或者说在构建那些能够病毒式传播的推文，并通过转发次数让它们尽可能快地传播开来。

sentences.en: The bigger those numbers, the supposedly better it is.
sentences.zh: 这些数字越大，据说效果就越好。

sentences.en: And what was the problem with that specifically?
sentences.zh: 这具体有什么问题呢？

sentences.en: I mean, what happens when you incentivize likes and retweets?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你激励点赞和转发时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, as you know, it can create behaviors that people are writing headlines for people to click so that eventually people see the ads behind that click.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如你所知，这可能会导致一些行为，比如人们撰写标题党文章来吸引用户点击，最终让人们看到点击背后的广告。

sentences.en: And is that really the right intention versus informing people about what's happening?
sentences.zh: 与告知人们正在发生的事情相比，这真的是正确的初衷吗？

sentences.en: And we certainly saw a lot of behaviors where people were constructing tweets just to get as much spread as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们确实看到了很多这样的行为：人们构建推文仅仅是为了获得尽可能广泛的传播。

sentences.en: And then we saw even more sophisticated attacks around that where people found out ways to game the systems in order to get more visibility
sentences.zh: 然后我们看到了围绕这一点更复杂的攻击，人们找到了玩转系统的方法，以便获得更高的曝光度

sentences.en: and to get their message higher than someone else.
sentences.zh: 并让他们的信息排在其他人之前。

sentences.en: So yeah, I mean, I think that spread without necessarily substance is in a sense of that can be dangerous.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我的意思是，我认为缺乏实质内容的盲目传播在某种意义上可能是危险的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this is coming back to this idea of nuance and whether that's possible.
sentences.zh: 所以这又回到了关于细微差别以及这是否可能的想法。

sentences.en: Or now I guess we're talking about whether it's rewarded on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 或者现在我猜我们在讨论这在推特上是否会得到回报。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, one of the things that we are experimenting with is a small little feature
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，我们正在试验的一个功能是

sentences.en: where if you retweet an article that you haven't actually even opened to look at, to read, we will give you a notification that says, hey, you haven't actually looked at this.
sentences.zh: 如果你转发了一篇甚至连点开看都没有看、读都没有读过的新鲜文章，我们会给你发送一条通知，上面写着，嘿，你其实并没有看过这篇东西。

sentences.en: Are you sure you want to spread it?
sentences.zh: 你确定要传播它吗？

sentences.en: Because that is a vector for information to spread that might be misleading and people to unknowingly participate in spreading misleading information.
sentences.zh: 因为那是传播可能具有误导性的信息的途径，会导致人们在不知情的情况下参与传播误导性信息。

sentences.en: I think there are people with intent.
sentences.zh: 我认为有些人是带着意图的。

sentences.en: And then there's a lot of people who are just kind of seeing things and seeing a headline or seeing a particular tweet and saying, oh my God, and then spreading it without...
sentences.zh: 还有很多人只是看到了一些东西，看到了一个标题或某条特定的推文，然后说，噢天哪，接着就在没有……的情况下将其传播出去。

sentences.en: Without knowing what's in it.
sentences.zh: 在不知道里面是什么内容的情况下。

sentences.en: Without knowing what's in it.
sentences.zh: 在不知道里面是什么内容的情况下。

sentences.en: And that is on us to help.
sentences.zh: 而我们需要为此提供帮助。

sentences.en: Why not just implement that?
sentences.zh: 为什么不直接把这个功能上线呢？

sentences.en: That's a pretty interesting idea.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当有趣的想法。

sentences.en: I'm trying to imagine what the downside of that would be of making sure people have actually seen what it is.
sentences.zh: 我正在想象，确保人们真正看清了内容到底是什么，会有什么负面影响。

sentences.en: You're pointing to some of our biggest issues in the dawn of the company.
sentences.zh: 你指出了我们在公司创立之初遇到的一些最大问题。

sentences.en: Why not just launch something?
sentences.zh: 为什么不直接推出某个东西呢？

sentences.en: Instead of think deeply about it and see what the ramifications are.
sentences.zh: 而不是深入思考并看看会产生什么后果。

sentences.en: And there are certainly positives that we can imagine, but there's probably some negatives as well.
sentences.zh: 我们当然可以想象出积极的方面，但也可能存在一些消极的方面。

sentences.en: And, you know, if everyone has access to this and everyone is using it, how does that change the discourse?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，如果每个人都能使用这个功能并且每个人都在使用它，这会如何改变话语环境？

sentences.en: And maybe it's entirely positive, but maybe it's not.
sentences.zh: 也许这完全是积极的，但也可能并非如此。

sentences.en: Maybe there's some underlying hidden assumptions that we're making that we need to verify or things that we're not seeing.
sentences.zh: 也许我们做出了一些需要验证的潜在隐藏假设，或者有一些我们没有看到的事情。

sentences.en: New vectors of attack, new vectors of abuse.
sentences.zh: 新的攻击途径，新的滥用途径。

sentences.en: So it's stepping back and like thinking deeply about every single small action that we're taking and having a hypothesis, like what we have with this particular
sentences.zh: 因此，我们要退一步，深入思考我们采取的每一个微小行动，并提出一个假设，就像我们对这个特定功能所做的那样

sentences.en: feature, and then testing it and seeing how it plays out on a small scale.
sentences.zh: 然后进行测试，看看它在小范围内是如何运作的。

sentences.en: And then as we gain confidence around it, yes, launch it to everyone.
sentences.zh: 随着我们对它越来越有信心，是的，再向所有人推出。

sentences.en: You're trying to learn the lessons of Twitter today, even as you think about changing the consequences of that.
sentences.zh: 即使你在考虑改变随之而来的后果，你也正试图吸取今天推特的教训。

sentences.en: The one thing I want our company to be incredible at, the one skill I want us to build is our capacity to learn.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们公司擅长的一件事、我希望我们培养的一项技能就是我们的学习能力。

sentences.en: It's a cycle of observe, learn, improve.
sentences.zh: 这是一个观察、学习、改进的循环。

sentences.en: If we can be incredible at that cycle, I'm confident we'll do the right things no matter what challenges we're facing.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能把这个循环做到极致，我有信心，无论我们面临什么挑战，我们都会做出正确的事情。

sentences.en: If we become too rigid,
sentences.zh: 如果我们变得过于死板

sentences.en: in coming up with an idea like we just discussed and saying, oh, let's just launch it and hope for the beSt. We're going to become more irrelevant or dangerous.
sentences.zh: 在提出像我们刚才讨论的那样的想法时说，哦，让我们直接上线吧，祈祷一切顺利。我们将变得更加不合时宜或者说更加危险。

sentences.en: And we just can't afford that.
sentences.zh: 而我们根本承担不起这样的代价。

sentences.en: Would you agree, this might seem harsh, that you have not been incredible about that?
sentences.zh: 你是否会同意——这听起来可能有点刺耳——你们在这方面做得并不是非常出色？

sentences.en: And maybe not even especially good at it?
sentences.zh: 甚至可能称不上特别好？

sentences.en: About learning?
sentences.zh: 关于学习？

sentences.en: About the pace of observing, learning, changing, and improving.
sentences.zh: 关于观察、学习、改变和改进的速度。

sentences.en: I would agree that we haven't been awesome, but I think we're getting better and better every single day.
sentences.zh: 我承认我们一直以来表现得不够惊艳，但我认为我们每天都在变得越来越好。

sentences.en: And I think that is on display publicly, especially in this past year, around everything
sentences.zh: 我认为这在公开场合是有目共睹的，特别是在过去的一年里，围绕我们所学到的所有东西

sentences.en: that we've learned and how we have evolved our policies and evolved our actions and our enforcement.
sentences.zh: 以及我们如何演进我们的政策、演进我们的行动和执法力度。

sentences.en: And I would say that the transparency the company has with the world right now is unique and something I'm very, very proud of and goes much farther than the moSt.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，目前公司对世界的透明度是独一无二的，这也是我感到非常非常自豪的一点，并且远远超出了大多数公司的水平。

sentences.en: So let's talk about algorithms for a moment and how you're thinking about those.
sentences.zh: 所以我们来花点时间谈谈算法以及你们是如何看待它们的。

sentences.en: What about the intentional surfacing by Twitter of particular types of messages, messages that tend to be hot, emotional, to draw lots of eyeballs, controversial?
sentences.zh: 推特有意将特定类型的消息推送到前台，比如那些往往很热门、充满情绪化、能吸引大量眼球、具有争议性的消息，对此你们怎么看？

sentences.en: Should that have worked differently?
sentences.zh: 这本该以不同的方式运作吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's not an end point.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这并不是终点。

sentences.en: So these algorithms are constantly evolving.
sentences.zh: 所以这些算法是在不断演进的。

sentences.en: So it's not a past tense where we can't change things.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是过去式，并不意味着我们无法改变事情。

sentences.en: But a lot of the algorithms are built on how people engage with the content.
sentences.zh: 但许多算法都是建立在人们如何与内容进行互动的基石之上的。

sentences.en: And in the simplest form, are people retweeting this tweet?
sentences.zh: 最简单的形式就是：人们是否在转发这条推文？

sentences.en: Are people replying to it?
sentences.zh: 人们是否在回复它？

sentences.en: Are people liking it?
sentences.zh: 人们是否在点赞它？

sentences.en: And if you stop there, then you get to a result where some of the most salacious or controversial tweets will naturally rise to the top because those are the things that
sentences.zh: 如果你到此为止，那么你得到的结果就是，一些最耸人听闻或最具争议的推文自然会脱颖而出、跃居榜首，因为这些正是

sentences.en: people naturally click on or share without thinking about it or reply to.
sentences.zh: 人们不假思索就会自然去点击、分享或回复的内容。

sentences.en: So there has to be some balancing effect to that.
sentences.zh: 因此，必须对此有一种平衡效应。

sentences.en: It can't just be a pure read of that signal.
sentences.zh: 它不能仅仅是对该信号的纯粹解读。

sentences.en: It has to take in other signals.
sentences.zh: 它必须纳入其他信号。

sentences.en: I think the most important thing...
sentences.zh: 我认为最重要的是……

sentences.en: Was it at one point basically a pure read of those signals?
sentences.zh: 它在某个阶段基本上是对这些信号的纯粹解读吗？

sentences.en: I wasn't fully present in all the decisions around how those were constructed originally, but I'm sure it was because you have to start somewhere.
sentences.zh: 对于最初如何构建这些决策的所有细节，我当时并未完全在场，但我确信肯定是这样的，因为你必须从某个地方开始。

sentences.en: And then you have to evolve based on what you learn.
sentences.zh: 然后你必须根据你所学到的东西进行演进。

sentences.en: I think it does point to a few issues around algorithms that we as a company and also an industry need to solve for.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实指出了围绕算法的一些问题，作为一家公司以及整个行业，我们需要去解决这些问题。

sentences.en: They are way too much of a black box.
sentences.zh: 它们在很大程度上还是一个黑盒。

sentences.en: They are not written in such a way that they express what criteria they're using to make decisions or even can express how they made a particular decision.
sentences.zh: 它们的编写方式并没有表达出它们在做决定时使用了什么标准，甚至无法表达它们是如何做出某个特定决定的。

sentences.en: And that's important certainly when you consider a ranking algorithm and what you see versus what you don't see.
sentences.zh: 当你考虑到排名算法以及你所看到的内容与你未看到的内容时，这一点当然很重要。

sentences.en: So we need to open up and be transparent around how our algorithms work and how they're used and maybe even enable people to choose their own algorithms to
sentences.zh: 因此，我们需要保持开放，并就我们的算法如何工作以及它们是如何被使用的保持透明，甚至可能允许人们选择他们自己的算法来

sentences.en: rank the content or to create their own algorithms to rank it.
sentences.zh: 对内容进行排名，或者创建他们自己的算法来进行排名。

sentences.en: To be that open, I think would be pretty incredible so that we can all come to better solutions because it affects society in such large ways.
sentences.zh: 能够做到如此开放，我认为将是一件相当了不起的事情，这样我们才能共同找到更好的解决方案，因为它对社会的影响是如此巨大。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 人人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Jack, can you give us a vision for Twitter, for the future of Twitter?
sentences.zh: 杰克，你能给我们描绘一下推特的愿景吗，关于推特未来的愿景？

sentences.en: Can you describe how its incentives and algorithm in this vision work?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下在这个愿景中，它的激励机制和算法是如何运作的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, what they reward and what that version of Twitter actually looks like?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它们奖励什么？那个版本的推特到底是什么样子的？

sentences.en: Help us see it.
sentences.zh: 帮我们想象一下。

sentences.en: Well, what I believe we're building is a conversation layer of the internet.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我相信我们正在构建的是互联网的对话层。

sentences.en: I believe so fundamentally in the promises of the internet, what it enables in our world.
sentences.zh: 我无比坚信互联网的承诺，以及它在我们世界中所能实现的功能。

sentences.en: And what I think Twitter represents is the conversation layer of that and the public conversation layer in particular.
sentences.zh: 我认为推特所代表的是其中的对话层，尤其是公共对话层。

sentences.en: And I think one of the things I get really excited about as I look at the trends of technology are number one, the trends of translation technology and real-time translation.
sentences.zh: 当我审视技术趋势时，让我感到非常兴奋的事情之一，第一就是翻译技术和实时翻译的趋势。

sentences.en: And I think we're moving from a world where a lot of people had to normalize around the top
sentences.zh: 我认为我们正在告别这样一个世界：很多人为了彼此沟通，不得不去适应前

sentences.en: three languages in order to communicate with each other, such as English and Spanish and Mandarin.
sentences.zh: 三大语言，比如英语、西班牙语和普通话。

sentences.en: And given what we're able to now build with translation technologies, we're actually able to
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们现在利用翻译技术能够构建出的成果，我们实际上能够

sentences.en: realize a future where when I come to a service like Twitter, I can express myself in my own dialect and anyone in the world can understand it in real time.
sentences.zh: 实现这样一种未来：当我来到像推特这样的服务平台时，我可以用我自己的方言表达自己，而世界上任何人都可以实时理解它。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But beyond the language thing for a minute, just because I want to be super clear about this,
sentences.zh: 但先抛开语言问题不谈，因为我想对此超级明确，

sentences.en: to give this to me in a way that I think a casual listener would understand, if I'm saying to you
sentences.zh: 为了让一个普通听众也能理解，如果我对你

sentences.en: right now, for me and for many people, Twitter feels like a place where people go to share and to
sentences.zh: 说，对我以及许多人来说，推特感觉就像是一个人们去分享、

sentences.en: reshare and to comment on emotional and attention-grabbing and often divisive messages.
sentences.zh: 重新分享并评论那些情绪化、吸引眼球且往往具有分化性的消息的地方。

sentences.en: How do I describe that and experience that in three years, in five years?
sentences.zh: 三年后、五年后，我该如何描述和体验它？

sentences.en: What's fundamentally different about it?
sentences.zh: 它有什么根本的不同吗？

sentences.en: Or maybe it's not.
sentences.zh: 或者也许并没有什么不同。

sentences.en: Again, I think that the reason I talked about translation is because you have more voices and you have more people participating.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，我之所以谈到翻译，是因为这样会有更多声音，会有更多人参与进来。

sentences.en: And I think that is important.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很重要。

sentences.en: We don't have enough people participating in this in a way that they're comfortable with.
sentences.zh: 我们没有足够的人以一种让他们感到舒适的方式参与进来。

sentences.en: So you want Twitter to be a better reflection of the whole world, of more people?
sentences.zh: 所以你希望推特能更好地反映整个世界、容纳更多的人？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But do you think that would solve the civility question that we're dealing with?
sentences.zh: 但你认为这能解决我们正在处理的文明礼貌问题吗？

sentences.en: I'm not saying it solves it.
sentences.zh: 我并没有说它能解决这个问题。

sentences.en: I mean, isn't it quite possible that more...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，难道很有可能更多……

sentences.en: I'm not saying it solves it.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说它能解决这个问题。

sentences.en: But as we have more representation around the world, then it shifts into another issue and another challenge, is how do you focus on relevance?
sentences.zh: 但随着我们在世界各地拥有更多的代表性，它就会转化为另一个问题和挑战，那就是如何专注于相关性？

sentences.en: And what is relevant to me and what's not relevant to me?
sentences.zh: 什么对我有相关性，什么对我没有相关性？

sentences.en: And that's where the algorithms come in.
sentences.zh: 这就是算法发挥作用的地方。

sentences.en: And relevance can't just be, did I write something that is contentious or like written in a way that
sentences.zh: 相关性不能仅仅是：我写的东西是否具有争议性，或者其写作方式

sentences.en: is meant to spread, but is it actually viable and relevant to a certain population or a certain aspect of the population?
sentences.zh: 旨在传播，而是它对特定人群或某一部分人群是否真的切实可行且具有相关性？

sentences.en: And there are going to be certain conversations that span communities and span nations and span cultures, but the majority of them are not.
sentences.zh: 将会有某些对话跨越社区、跨越国家、跨越文化，但大多数对话并非如此。

sentences.en: The majority of them are going to be more localized.
sentences.zh: 它们大多数会更具地方局限性。

sentences.en: So I think, you know, and I don't know what the timeframe is, but you'll see a Twitter that has, you know, this blurring of a very localized conversation, whether that locality be
sentences.zh: 所以我想，你知道，我不知道时间表是什么，但你会看到这样一个推特：它有着这种高度本土化对话的模糊界限，无论是这种局部性属于

sentences.en: cultural or geography-based or topical-based.
sentences.zh: 文化上的、地理位置上的还是基于特定话题的。

sentences.en: That was not the experience of Facebook in, say, Myanmar.
sentences.zh: 这并不是Facebook在比如缅甸的经历。

sentences.en: I mean, there are places where social media has been expanded and people have deployed those social media services in pretty horrible ways, in ways that have been genocidal.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在某些地方，社交媒体得到了扩展，人们以非常可怕的方式部署了这些社交媒体服务，甚至是达到了种族灭绝的程度。

sentences.en: So isn't it possible that what we're talking about here just spreads across the world?
sentences.zh: 所以，难道我们在这里讨论的事情不会蔓延到世界各地吗？

sentences.en: Because if the fundamentals don't change about what is shared, why it's shared, what our eyeballs are drawn to, what the kind of
sentences.zh: 因为如果关于分享什么、为什么分享、我们的眼球被什么所吸引、以及在推特这样的地方这个系统的根本

sentences.en: fundamental kind of incentives of this system are in a place like Twitter, then aren't we just about to export it to other places?
sentences.zh: 激励机制是什么这些基本要素没有改变，那么我们难道不是正准备把它输出到其他地方吗？

sentences.en: Isn't more attention on those problems helpful though?
sentences.zh: 然而，对这些问题给予更多关注难道不是有帮助的吗？

sentences.en: Isn't more acknowledgement on those issues unfolding in real time in the public important so that we can acknowledge it so that more people can try to help solve them?
sentences.zh: 在公共场合实时展开对这些正在发生的问题的更多承认，难道不重要吗？这样我们才能承认它，让更多人尝试帮忙解决它们。

sentences.en: So people who may not have had access because they didn't understand it in the past now understand it and can jump in, even if they're not particularly in the location.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，那些过去因为听不懂而无法接触到的人现在也能听懂了，并且可以加入进来，即使他们并不在那个特定的地点。

sentences.en: I guess that depends on if you think Twitter, and I'm curious what you think, is a reflection of society or an amplifier or creator of divisiveness and polarization.
sentences.zh: 我想这取决于你是否认为推特——我也很好奇你的看法——是社会的反映，还是分化和两极分化的放大器或制造者。

sentences.en: It's kind of that chicken and egg thing all over again.
sentences.zh: 这有点像先有鸡还是先有蛋的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, like any tool, it can be both.
sentences.zh: 对，就像任何工具一样，它既可以好也可以坏。

sentences.en: With all these tools that we build, all technologies,
sentences.zh: 在我们建造的所有这些工具中，所有的技术中，

sentences.en: we start using them in one way and we discover all these probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我们开始时以某种方式使用它们，然后我们发现了所有这些问题。

sentences.en: And then we address those and we continue that iteration.
sentences.zh: 接着我们解决这些问题，并继续进行这种迭代。

sentences.en: This is not unique to this time.
sentences.zh: 这并不是这个时代所独有的。

sentences.en: It goes back throughout our history
sentences.zh: 它贯穿了我们的整个历史，

sentences.en: as a civilization.
sentences.zh: 作为一个文明。

sentences.en: You can't pick any tool that wasn't used in some way in both a positive and a negative.
sentences.zh: 你挑不出任何一个在某种程度上没有被用于正面和负面方面的工具。

sentences.en: And the same is true for the tools of the internet.
sentences.zh: 互联网的工具也是如此。

sentences.en: The reason I'm asking that original question is I want to know how you are going to try to ensure that it's not both, right?
sentences.zh: 我问最初那个问题的原因是，我想知道你将如何努力确保它不会走向两极，对吧？

sentences.en: How do you ensure before you grow again globally that you've solved kind of the root problem?
sentences.zh: 在你再次在全球扩张之前，你如何确保自己已经解决了某种根源问题？

sentences.en: And what does that algorithm look like?
sentences.zh: 那个算法是什么样子的？

sentences.en: I think that's just the wrong way to think about it, that there's one solution.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种认为存在单一解决方案的想法是完全错误的。

sentences.en: I only heard you really say that the solution was growth in translation.
sentences.zh: 我只听你真正说过，解决方案在翻译中就是增长。

sentences.en: So I really want to be sure I give you a chance and that we understand what you see as, even if it's not just one solution, maybe a very clear, specific set of solutions.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很想确保我给你一个机会，并且让我们明白你认为的——即使不只是一个解决方案，也许是一套非常清晰、具体的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's just a constant, to me, it's a constant iteration.
sentences.zh: 对我和我而言，这只是一种持续不断的迭代。

sentences.en: It's a constant push to be steps ahead of how people might utilize this in a negative way, address that, and then see new potential use cases that are negative.
sentences.zh: 这是一种持续的推动，旨在领先于人们可能以负面方式利用它的方式几步，解决这个问题，然后看到新的潜在负面用例。

sentences.en: If we try to develop a perfect system that solves the problem, quote-unquote, we're just going to get it wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果我们试图开发一个完美的系统来解决所谓的问题，我们只会搞砸。

sentences.en: And it's going to evolve past it.
sentences.zh: 而且它会超越这个系统不断演变。

sentences.en: It's shown itself in that way in so many different cases.
sentences.zh: 它在如此多的不同案例中都表现出了这一点。

sentences.en: I wonder if I can just get an example from you.
sentences.zh: 我想知道我能否向你讨教一个例子。

sentences.en: Beyond the experiment you're running on making sure people have opened articles before sharing, how you might keep iterating for good on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 除了你正在进行的确保人们在分享前打开文章的实验之外，你可能如何在Twitter上继续进行良性迭代。

sentences.en: I mean, there's tons of examples, but one example is another experiment that we've run in the past and that we're running, which is for any particular article that is shared,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有很多例子，但其中一个例子是我们过去运行过、现在也在运行的另一个实验，那就是对于任何分享的特定文章，

sentences.en: you might see one point of view in this direction, another point of view that is slightly different, and another point of view that is completely different,
sentences.zh: 你可能会看到这个方向的一种观点，稍微不同的另一种观点，以及完全不同的另一种观点，

sentences.en: just to show and kind of break through some of the bubbles that we tend to naturally build.
sentences.zh: 只是为了展示并打破一些我们倾向于自然而然建立的气泡。

sentences.en: Because I think that the hope and the hypothesis is that you might see these different takes and it might incentivize you to really dig deep into the article
sentences.zh: 因为我认为我们的希望和假设是，你可能会看到这些不同的看法，这可能会激励你真正深入钻研这篇文章，

sentences.en: or actually watch the video that's being shared so you can have, you know, your own informed point of view and share your opinion as well.
sentences.zh: 或者实际观看正在分享的视频，这样你就可以拥有，你知道的，自己知情的观点，并分享你的意见。

sentences.en: And the more of that variety and diverse perspective we have, you know, we get to better answers.
sentences.zh: 这种多样性和多元的视角越多，你知道的，我们就能得到更好的答案。

sentences.en: Of course, one thing you have done that we haven't talked about a lot here is you've applied a layer of kind of fact-checking and flagging of things that are not accurate
sentences.zh: 当然，你做过的一件我们在这里没有过多讨论的事情是，你应用了一种事实核查和标记不准确内容的机制，

sentences.en: and may have, you know, significant public consequence, especially when it comes to something like the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 这些内容可能具有，你知道的，重大的公共后果，尤其是当涉及到像冠状病毒这样的事情时。

sentences.en: And as we're talking about your evolution from growth to a focus on questions of speech, I wonder, do you care if groups like conservatives in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在我们讨论你从增长到关注言论问题的演变时，我想知道，你是否在意像美国保守派这样的群体

sentences.en: feel like you have a bias against them?
sentences.zh: 觉得你对他们有偏见？

sentences.en: I mean, one of your peers, Mark Zuckerberg, does seem to care about that quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你的同行之一马克·扎克伯格，似乎确实相当在意这一点。

sentences.en: Do you care if some meaningful percentage of Americans feel that you are somehow suppressing them, censoring them as part of your iterations and your growth?
sentences.zh: 你是否在意相当大比例的美国人觉得作为你的迭代和增长的一部分，你不知何故在压制他们、审查他们？

sentences.en: I absolutely do care.
sentences.zh: 我绝对在意。

sentences.en: I come from a very conservative state of Missouri, where St. Louis, my hometown, is much more liberal.
sentences.zh: 我来自一个非常保守的密苏里州，而我的家乡圣路易斯要自由得多。

sentences.en: So it's in this basket of conservatism.
sentences.zh: 所以它处于保守主义的这个范畴中。

sentences.en: And my dad is very much a conservative.
sentences.zh: 我的父亲也非常保守。

sentences.en: So I absolutely do care that we're building a system that does not take our own bias into account, but feels fair.
sentences.zh: 所以我绝对在意我们正在构建一个不把我们自己的偏见考虑在内、而是让人感觉公平的系统。

sentences.en: And I think one way to show that is continue to be a lot more transparent around our decisions, continue to be clear in our policies, which, you know, we haven't been in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为展示这一点的途径之一就是继续对我们的决策保持更大的透明度，继续明确我们的政策，你知道的，我们在过去并没有做到这一点。

sentences.en: And we haven't been transparent around our actions and the why behind it.
sentences.zh: 而且我们在我们的行动以及背后的原因方面一直不够透明。

sentences.en: I think that brings us naturally to President Trump and his own use of Twitter.
sentences.zh: 我认为这自然而然地把我们引向了特朗普总统和他对Twitter的使用。

sentences.en: And there's perhaps no one who has better grasped the incentives of Twitter and how to exploit them than Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 也许没有人比唐纳德·特朗普更好地理解了Twitter的激励机制以及如何利用它们。

sentences.en: I once sat in his office with him before he was president, and he talked to me about how savvy a user of Twitter he was and is.
sentences.zh: 在他当总统之前，我曾与他一起坐在他的办公室里，他跟我谈到他是多么精通Twitter的用户，过去是，现在也是。

sentences.en: And he's turned out to be very savvy about it.
sentences.zh: 事实证明他在这方面非常精明。

sentences.en: Would you agree with that?
sentences.zh: 你同意这一点吗？

sentences.en: I mean, that Donald Trump is one of the most deft users of this platform you've created?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，唐纳德·特朗普是你所创建的这个平台上最娴熟的用户之一？

sentences.en: He's definitely used it to great effect.
sentences.zh: 他绝对把它用得非常有效。

sentences.en: I wouldn't say he's necessarily the most, because it's just really a question of, like, what your goals are.
sentences.zh: 我不会说他一定是之最，因为这真的只是一个关于你的目标是什么的问题。

sentences.en: I would say, like, his usage tends to be consistent.
sentences.zh: 我会说，他的使用往往是一致的。

sentences.en: He started in a particular way, and that has remained consistent to today.
sentences.zh: 他以特定的方式开始，并且这种方式一直持续到今天。

sentences.en: But I guess what I'm saying is he's taken advantage of the existing incentive structure.
sentences.zh: 但我想说的是，他利用了现有的激励结构。

sentences.en: Does that feel right?
sentences.zh: 这感觉对吗？

sentences.en: And he continues to kind of use it to his advantage.
sentences.zh: 而且他继续在某种程度上利用它来为自己谋利。

sentences.en: And sort of given the emotional quality of his tweets,
sentences.zh: 鉴于他的推文带有某种情绪色彩，

sentences.en: it suggests that Twitter is still very much rewarding those incentives.
sentences.zh: 这表明Twitter在很大程度上仍然在奖励这些激励机制。

sentences.en: How would you say that?
sentences.zh: 你觉得会是怎样？

sentences.en: How would you say it's rewarding?
sentences.zh: 你觉得它怎么就在奖励了？

sentences.en: Well, if—
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果——

sentences.en: Versus society rewarding that.
sentences.zh: 与社会奖励它相对而言。

sentences.en: Versus, you know, the media constantly pointing the cameras on that and putting all the attention on that.
sentences.zh: 与，你知道的，媒体不断把摄像机对准它并将所有注意力集中在那上面相对而言。

sentences.en: Like, how is people using Twitter different from the approach that we're seeing elsewhere?
sentences.zh: 就像，人们使用Twitter的方式与我们在其他地方看到的做法有何不同？

sentences.en: I believe that was a rhetorical question, but TV is a mediated, somewhat mediated form.
sentences.zh: 我相信这是一个反问句，但电视是一种经过中介的、在某种程度上被中介的形式。

sentences.en: And for the most part, until very recently, when the president wanted to say something that contained misinformation, that contained an outright lie, that called a judge a name,
sentences.zh: 而且在绝大多数情况下，直到最近，当总统想说一些包含错误信息、包含彻头彻尾的谎言、辱骂法官的话时，

sentences.en: that expressed a racist sentiment, that pretty much was his to-do on your platform without any real layer or mediation.
sentences.zh: 表达一种种族主义情绪时，在你的平台上基本上就是他想怎么做就怎么做，没有任何真正的层级或中介。

sentences.en: And it got tons and tons and tons of retweets and pickup and attention.
sentences.zh: 而且它获得了成千上万的转发、转载和关注。

sentences.en: Well, you're completely ignoring the layer of people who push back on any one particular tweet or reply to it or spread it with a correction to their followers
sentences.zh: 嗯，你完全忽视了这样一群人：他们对任何一条特定的推特进行反击，回复它，或者带着对粉丝的纠正将其传播开来，

sentences.en: and to hashtags or search terMs.
sentences.zh: 以及发到标签或搜索词中。

sentences.en: So there is mediation, but it's a question of the people doing the mediation versus the centralized media doing it.
sentences.zh: 所以这里是有中介的，但这只是进行中介的人与进行中介的集中化媒体之间的区别。

sentences.en: So you're right there.
sentences.zh: 所以你说的对。

sentences.en: And again, like, a lot of our policies and focus in this particular area are really focused on, like, the velocity and the spread of information and the gaming of these systems
sentences.zh: 再说一次，就像我们在这个特定领域的许多政策和焦点一样，确实集中在信息的传播速度和传播范围以及对这些系统的利用上，

sentences.en: and where this might have harm if people were to see it and take it out of context.
sentences.zh: 以及如果人们看到并断章取义，这可能会在哪里造成伤害。

sentences.en: So we did label tweets of his that we felt could be harmful because they may have led people to believe that they were registered to vote when, in fact, they weren't.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们确实给我们认为可能有害的他的推特贴上了标签，因为它们可能会导致人们相信他们已经登记投票，而实际上他们并没有。

sentences.en: And we didn't take the tweets down.
sentences.zh: 我们没有删除这些推特。

sentences.en: We appended them with, annotated them with information as to the facts expressed by the various institutions that were doing the work around registering voters.
sentences.zh: 我们附加了信息，用从事选民登记工作的各个机构所表达的事实对它们进行了注释。

sentences.en: So I think it's important that we do recognize, number one, that these annotations are happening by the crowd in real time, all the time.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得很重要的一点是我们要认识到，第一，这些注释是由大众实时、一直在进行的。

sentences.en: And number two, there are particular areas, such as voter suppression and election integrity, that we should also take action upon.
sentences.zh: 第二，有一些特定领域，例如选民压制和选举完整性，我们也应该采取行动。

sentences.en: And we should make that policy as tight as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们应该让该政策尽可能严格。

sentences.en: And we should make those interventions as infrequent as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们应该让这些干预措施尽可能不频繁。

sentences.en: But the reality is they have to be there.
sentences.zh: 但现实是它们必须存在。

sentences.en: Are you prepared to ban Donald Trump from Twitter if you feel that he has repeatedly violated your rules, your terms of service?
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得唐纳德·特朗普一再违反你的规则、你的服务条款，你准备好禁止他使用Twitter吗？

sentences.en: And I ask this because you have banned certain figures from Twitter, the most famous being Alex Jones of InfoWars,
sentences.zh: 我这样问是因为你已经禁止了某些人物使用Twitter，最著名的是InfoWars的亚历克斯·琼斯，

sentences.en: because you all said that he had violated your rules around abusive behavior.
sentences.zh: 因为你们所有人说他违反了你们关于辱骂行为的规则。

sentences.en: So does Donald Trump break those rules?
sentences.zh: 那么唐纳德·特朗普打破了这些规则吗？

sentences.en: And, you know, I mean that because, like I said before, he attacks judges or he calls women dogs or he spreads false and misleading information on a routine basis.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我的意思是，就像我之前说的，他攻击法官，或者他称女性为母狗，或者他例行公事般地传播虚假和误导性信息。

sentences.en: Yeah, so we, independent of any particular account, we hold all accounts to the same rules.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以我们，不考虑任何特定的账户，我们对所有账户都适用相同的规则。

sentences.en: But, you know, if there are particular egregious aspects of violations of our terms of service, we won't hesitate to take action on the accounts
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，如果存在严重违反我们服务条款的特定恶劣方面，我们毫不犹豫地会对这些账户采取行动，

sentences.en: and use every tool that we have together with us.
sentences.zh: 并与我们一起使用我们拥有的每一项工具。

sentences.en: So independent of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，不论美国总统或世界上任何领导人如何，如果我们认为有必要，我们都会采取行动。

sentences.en: president or any leader around the world, we will take action if we feel it necessary.
sentences.zh: 我知道人们抗拒假设，特别是像你这样职位的人，但有时它们可能很重要。

sentences.en: I know people resist hypotheticals, especially people in your position, but sometimes they can be important.
sentences.zh: 比方说今天是11月3日、4日、5日、6日或7日，因为这将是一场非常不寻常的选举。

sentences.en: And let's say that it is November 3rd or 4th or 5th or 6th or 7th because this is going to be a very unusual election.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统登上Twitter宣布他赢了，尽管这还不清楚或不准确。

sentences.en: And President Trump takes to Twitter and declares that he is the winner, even though that's not yet clear or accurate.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，我们的民主制度在那一刻将受到非常严峻的考验。

sentences.en: And in some ways, our democratic system at that moment is going to be very severely tested.
sentences.zh: 如果他在Twitter上发表该声明，你该怎么做？

sentences.en: And if he makes that declaration on Twitter, what do you do?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我会寻找向过去学习的机会。

sentences.en: Well, I guess I would look for opportunities to learn from the paSt.
sentences.zh: 难道我们没有看到其中一些情况早在戈尔和小布什在佛罗里达州时就上演过了吗？关于感到困惑，

sentences.en: So do we not see some of this play out way back during Gore and Bush in Florida in terms of being, you know, confused as to what the end state around what the election was
sentences.zh: 不知道选举的最终状态是什么以及它是如何演变的？

sentences.en: and how that evolved?
sentences.zh: 所以在历史中寻找经验教训，并与我们的同行和公民社会合作，真正了解发生了什么，然后做出明智的决定。

sentences.en: So look for lessons in history and work with our peers and civil society to really understand what's going on and then make an informed decision.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，这是一个假设，我们需要就围绕选举的对话的完整性

sentences.en: But as you said, it's a hypothetical that we, you know, just need to think a lot more about in terms of like the integrity of the conversation around the election
sentences.zh: 以及这意味着什么、长什么样进行更多思考。

sentences.en: and what that means and what that looks like.
sentences.zh: 这是我们本国公众对话健康状况的首要焦点领域，也就是围绕选举的对话。

sentences.en: And this is our number one focus area for health of the public conversation in this country, which is the conversation around elections.
sentences.zh: 你会看到我们继续演变我们的政策，以保护围绕选举的对话的完整性。

sentences.en: And you will see us continue to evolve our policy to protect the integrity of the conversation around elections.
sentences.zh: 听你说话，杰克，你非常克制。

sentences.en: Listening to you talk, Jack, you are very measured.
sentences.zh: 你很冷静。

sentences.en: You are calm.
sentences.zh: 你很谨慎。

sentences.en: You are careful.
sentences.zh: 你是一家平台的首席执行官，该平台在其当前形式下靠情绪蓬勃发展，而正如我们所说，它因提升最具煽动性、轰动性、充满情绪的观点而臭名昭著。

sentences.en: And you're the CEO of a platform that in its current form thrives on emotion that's notorious for elevating the most, as we've said, kind of hot, sensational, charged views.
sentences.zh: 我们的一位同事在预料到这次谈话并了解你的基调时开玩笑说，如果你发了一条听起来像杰克·多西的推特，

sentences.en: A colleague of ours anticipating his conversation and kind of knowing your tone joked that if you tweet something that sounds like Jack Dorsey,
sentences.zh: 它在Twitter上可能不会那么受欢迎。

sentences.en: it probably won't do all that well on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 说实话，

sentences.en: And honestly,
sentences.zh: 说实话，

sentences.en: and honestly,
sentences.zh: Twitter看起来不完全像你。

sentences.en: Twitter doesn't seem like you exactly.
sentences.zh: 而你看起来也不完全像Twitter。

sentences.en: And you don't exactly seem like Twitter.
sentences.zh: 那你现在喜欢Twitter吗？

sentences.en: So do you like Twitter right now?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢它现在的样子吗？

sentences.en: Do you like what it's become?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢它今天存在的模样吗？

sentences.en: Do you like what it is as it exists today?
sentences.zh: 对Twitter的一种看法，我认为这是一种非常具体的看法，那就是它完全集中在，你知道的，这些反应式的、情绪化的、标题党式的、点击诱饵式的推特上。

sentences.en: One view of Twitter, and I think it's a very specific view, is that it's all focused on, you know, these reactionary, emotional, headline, clickbait tweets.
sentences.zh: 而这根本不是我们在世界上的大多数使用情况的现实。

sentences.en: And that's just not the reality of the majority of our usage in the world.
sentences.zh: 并不是说关注新闻和政治以及这如何改变话语不重要。

sentences.en: And not that it's not important to focus on news and politics and how that changes the discourse.
sentences.zh: 并不是说尽我们所能去修复它不重要。

sentences.en: And not that it's not important to help do everything that we can to fix it.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这样做的途径是倾听并以某种方式使用该工具，以便我们能够真正了解社会是如何演变的，技术是如何演变的，

sentences.en: But I think the way to do that is to listen and to use the tool in such a way that we can really understand how society is evolving, how technology is evolving,
sentences.zh: 我们可以利用这些来首先帮助解决这些问题。

sentences.en: that we can utilize to help these problems in the first place.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我使用Twitter不是为了获得尽可能多的传播。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I don't use Twitter to get as much spread as possible.
sentences.zh: 我用它来倾听、观察，并最终了解我们的世界、我的世界和我自己。

sentences.en: I use it to listen and to observe and to understand our world and my world and myself, ultimately.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果Twitter没有从当前形式发生有意义的改变，它是否仍然存在严重缺陷？

sentences.en: But if Twitter doesn't change meaningfully from its current form, does it remain deeply flawed?
sentences.zh: 如果我们不改变Twitter，那就太愚蠢了。

sentences.en: It would be silly for us not to change Twitter.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，它会，它应该，如果不改变，如果不不断演变，如果不认识到差距和变得更好的机会，它就会变得无足轻重。

sentences.en: So, yes, it would be, it would, it should become irrelevant if it doesn't change, if it doesn't constantly evolve, and if it doesn't recognize gaps and opportunities to get better.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，绝对会。

sentences.en: So, yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 那将是一个，

sentences.en: That would be a,
sentences.zh: 我们在那种特定情况下会招致这种无足轻重。

sentences.en: that we would earn that irrelevance in that particular case.
sentences.zh: 好的，杰克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Well, Jack, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 我们感谢你的时间。

sentences.en: We appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 感谢参与。

sentences.en: Thanks for doing it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
